words.definitionEn: to delineate sth - to describe or set out something clearly and in detail
words.exampleEn: The report clearly delineates the responsibilities of local and central government.
words.exampleUz: Hisobot mahalliy va markaziy hokimiyat vazifalarini aniq belgilab beradi.

words.definitionEn: to posit that... - to suggest an idea as a starting point for discussion
words.exampleEn: Some economists posit that automation will create more jobs than it destroys.
words.exampleUz: Ba'zi iqtisodchilar avtomatlashtirish yo'q qilganidan ko'ra ko'proq ish o'rni yaratadi, degan fikrni ilgari suradi.

words.definitionEn: to contend that... - to argue firmly that something is true
words.exampleEn: Critics contend that free university education mainly benefits wealthy families.
words.exampleUz: Tanqidchilar bepul oliy ta'lim asosan badavlat oilalarga foyda keltiradi, deb ta'kidlaydi.

words.definitionEn: to elucidate sth - to explain something difficult so that it becomes clear
words.exampleEn: The second paragraph elucidates the link between poverty and poor health.
words.exampleUz: Ikkinchi xatboshi qashshoqlik va sog'liq muammolari o'rtasidagi bog'liqlikni ochib beradi.

words.definitionEn: to corroborate sth - to provide evidence that supports a claim or theory
words.exampleEn: Recent studies corroborate the view that early bilingualism improves memory.
words.exampleUz: So'nggi tadqiqotlar erta ikki tillilik xotirani yaxshilashi haqidagi qarashni tasdiqlaydi.

words.definitionEn: to articulate sth - to express an idea or feeling clearly in words
words.exampleEn: Young people are often unable to articulate their concerns about the future.
words.exampleUz: Yoshlar ko'pincha kelajak haqidagi tashvishlarini aniq ifodalab bera olmaydi.

words.definitionEn: to formulate a policy/an argument - to develop and express it carefully
words.exampleEn: The government has yet to formulate a clear policy on air pollution.
words.exampleUz: Hukumat hali havo ifloslanishi bo'yicha aniq siyosat ishlab chiqqani yo'q.

words.definitionEn: to exemplify sth - to be a typical example of something
words.exampleEn: Singapore exemplifies how strict regulation can reduce traffic congestion.
words.exampleUz: Singapur qat'iy tartibga solish tirbandlikni qanday kamaytirishiga yorqin misoldir.

words.definitionEn: to illustrate sth - to show that something is true by giving an example
words.exampleEn: This case illustrates the danger of relying on a single source of income.
words.exampleUz: Bu holat yagona daromad manbasiga tayanishning xavfini yaqqol ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: to outline sth - to describe the main points without going into detail
words.exampleEn: In this essay I will outline the main causes of youth unemployment.
words.exampleUz: Ushbu inshoda yoshlar ishsizligining asosiy sabablarini qisqacha bayon qilaman.

words.definitionEn: to encompass sth - to include a wide range of things
words.exampleEn: The term 'education' encompasses far more than formal schooling.
words.exampleUz: 'Ta'lim' atamasi rasmiy maktab ta'limidan ancha kengroq tushunchani qamrab oladi.

words.translation: o'zi bilan olib kelmoq, talab qilmoq
words.definitionEn: to entail sth - to involve something as a necessary part or result
words.exampleEn: Cutting carbon emissions will inevitably entail higher energy prices.
words.exampleUz: Uglerod chiqindilarini kamaytirish muqarrar ravishda energiya narxining oshishini keltirib chiqaradi.

words.definitionEn: to constitute sth - to be or form a particular whole
words.exampleEn: Women constitute nearly half of the country's workforce.
words.exampleUz: Ayollar mamlakat ishchi kuchining deyarli yarmini tashkil etadi.

words.definitionEn: to comprise sth - to consist of or be made up of particular parts
words.exampleEn: The sample comprised 200 students from five different regions.
words.exampleUz: Tanlanma beshta turli viloyatdan kelgan 200 nafar talabadan iborat edi.

words.definitionEn: to denote sth - to be a sign or symbol for something
words.exampleEn: In this graph, the dotted line denotes the average national income.
words.exampleUz: Ushbu grafikda punktir chiziq o'rtacha milliy daromadni bildiradi.

words.definitionEn: to attribute sth to sth - to say that something is caused by something else
words.exampleEn: Researchers attribute the fall in crime to better street lighting.
words.exampleUz: Tadqiqotchilar jinoyatchilik kamayishini ko'chalarning yaxshi yoritilishi bilan bog'lashadi.

words.definitionEn: to ascribe sth to sb/sth - to believe that something was caused by or belongs to someone
words.exampleEn: The author ascribes the country's rapid growth to reforms in education.
words.exampleUz: Muallif mamlakatning tez o'sishini ta'lim sohasidagi islohotlarga nisbat beradi.

words.definitionEn: to postulate that... - to suggest something is true as the basis of an argument
words.exampleEn: Early researchers postulated that language ability declines sharply after childhood.
words.exampleUz: Dastlabki tadqiqotchilar til qobiliyati bolalikdan keyin keskin pasayadi, deb faraz qilishgan.

words.definitionEn: to advance an argument/a theory - to put an idea forward for others to consider
words.exampleEn: The writer advances a strong argument in favour of free public transport.
words.exampleUz: Muallif bepul jamoat transporti foydasiga kuchli dalil ilgari suradi.

words.definitionEn: to put forward a proposal/an idea - to suggest it formally for discussion
words.exampleEn: Several experts have put forward proposals to reform the examination system.
words.exampleUz: Bir necha ekspert imtihon tizimini isloh qilish bo'yicha takliflar ilgari surdi.

words.definitionEn: to draw on sth - to use information, research or experience as a source
words.exampleEn: This essay draws on data from the latest national survey.
words.exampleUz: Ushbu insho so'nggi milliy so'rov ma'lumotlariga tayanadi.

words.definitionEn: to elaborate on sth - to give more detail about an idea you have mentioned
words.exampleEn: In the next section I will elaborate on the economic benefits of tourism.
words.exampleUz: Keyingi bo'limda turizmning iqtisodiy foydalarini kengroq tushuntirib beraman.

words.definitionEn: to reiterate sth - to repeat a point in order to emphasise it
words.exampleEn: To conclude, I would like to reiterate that prevention is cheaper than treatment.
words.exampleUz: Xulosa qilib, profilaktika davolashdan arzonroq ekanini qayta ta'kidlamoqchiman.

words.definitionEn: to underscore sth - to show clearly that something is important
words.exampleEn: The pandemic underscored the need for a stronger public health system.
words.exampleUz: Pandemiya kuchliroq sog'liqni saqlash tizimiga ehtiyoj borligini alohida ta'kidlab ko'rsatdi.

words.definitionEn: to synthesise information - to combine ideas from different sources into one whole
words.exampleEn: A good conclusion synthesises the main points rather than simply repeating them.
words.exampleUz: Yaxshi xulosa asosiy fikrlarni shunchaki takrorlamay, ularni umumlashtirib birlashtiradi.

words.definitionEn: to paraphrase sth - to express someone else's idea in your own words
words.exampleEn: Candidates should paraphrase the question rather than copy it word for word.
words.exampleUz: Nomzodlar savolni so'zma-so'z ko'chirmasdan, boshqa so'zlar bilan ifodalashi kerak.

words.definitionEn: to counter an argument - to reply to it with an opposing point
words.exampleEn: Supporters counter this argument by pointing to the sharp fall in accidents.
words.exampleUz: Tarafdorlar baxtsiz hodisalar keskin kamayganiga ishora qilib, bu dalilga e'tiroz bildiradi.

words.definitionEn: to rebut a claim - to argue with reasons that a statement is false
words.exampleEn: The minister rebutted claims that the reform had failed.
words.exampleUz: Vazir islohot muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi, degan da'volarga rad javobini berdi.

words.definitionEn: to dispute sth - to say that you do not think something is true or fair
words.exampleEn: Few people would dispute that access to clean water is a basic right.
words.exampleUz: Toza suvdan foydalanish asosiy huquq ekaniga kam odam e'tiroz qiladi.

words.definitionEn: to contest a claim/decision - to argue formally that it is wrong
words.exampleEn: Environmental groups contested the government's figures on emissions.
words.exampleUz: Ekologik guruhlar hukumatning chiqindilar bo'yicha raqamlariga qarshi chiqdi.

words.definitionEn: to qualify a statement - to add detail that makes it less absolute
words.exampleEn: I would qualify this claim by adding that the effect is only short-term.
words.exampleUz: Bu ta'sir faqat qisqa muddatli ekanini qo'shib, mazkur da'voni biroz cheklab aniqlashtirgan bo'lardim.

words.definitionEn: to clarify sth - to make an idea easier to understand
words.exampleEn: The introduction should clarify exactly what the essay will discuss.
words.exampleUz: Kirish qismi insho aynan nimani muhokama qilishiga aniqlik kiritishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: to demonstrate that... - to show clearly, usually by giving evidence
words.exampleEn: These figures demonstrate that public transport use has risen steadily.
words.exampleUz: Bu raqamlar jamoat transportidan foydalanish barqaror o'sganini isbotlab ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: to establish a fact/a link - to prove that something is true
words.exampleEn: Researchers have established a clear link between sleep and academic performance.
words.exampleUz: Tadqiqotchilar uyqu va o'zlashtirish o'rtasida aniq bog'liqlik borligini isbotlashdi.

words.definitionEn: to examine an issue - to look at it carefully in order to understand it
words.exampleEn: This essay examines both the causes and the effects of rural migration.
words.exampleUz: Ushbu insho qishloqdan ko'chishning ham sabablarini, ham oqibatlarini batafsil o'rganadi.

words.definitionEn: to investigate sth - to study a question carefully in order to find the truth
words.exampleEn: The study investigates why fewer girls choose engineering as a career.
words.exampleUz: Tadqiqot nima uchun qizlar muhandislikni kasb sifatida kamroq tanlashini o'rganadi.

words.definitionEn: to address a problem/an issue - to begin to deal with it seriously
words.exampleEn: Governments must address the root causes of unemployment, not just its symptoms.
words.exampleUz: Hukumatlar ishsizlikning faqat alomatlarini emas, chuqur sabablarini hal qilishga kirishishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: to tackle a problem - to make a determined effort to deal with it
words.exampleEn: No single country can tackle climate change on its own.
words.exampleUz: Hech bir davlat iqlim o'zgarishiga yolg'iz o'zi qarshi kurasha olmaydi.

words.definitionEn: to explore an idea - to examine it in order to understand it better
words.exampleEn: The following paragraphs explore three possible solutions to this problem.
words.exampleUz: Quyidagi xatboshilarda bu muammoning uchta mumkin bo'lgan yechimi ko'rib chiqiladi.

words.definitionEn: to review the evidence/literature - to look again at what is already known about a topic
words.exampleEn: The first section reviews the existing evidence on remote working.
words.exampleUz: Birinchi bo'limda masofaviy ish bo'yicha mavjud dalillar ko'rib chiqiladi.

words.definitionEn: a set of questions asked to many people in order to collect data
words.exampleEn: A recent survey found that most graduates work outside their field of study.
words.exampleUz: So'nggi so'rovnoma bitiruvchilarning aksariyati o'z yo'nalishidan tashqarida ishlashini ko'rsatdi.

words.definitionEn: to trace sth back to sth - to find the origin or development of something
words.exampleEn: The author traces the problem back to reforms introduced in the 1990s.
words.exampleUz: Muallif muammoning ildizi 1990-yillarda joriy etilgan islohotlarga borib taqalishini ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: to highlight sth - to draw attention to an important fact or problem
words.exampleEn: The graph highlights a sharp increase in energy consumption after 2015.
words.exampleUz: Grafik 2015-yildan keyin energiya iste'moli keskin oshganini ajratib ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: to convey an idea/a message - to communicate it so that others understand
words.exampleEn: Charts often convey complex information more effectively than long paragraphs.
words.exampleUz: Diagrammalar murakkab ma'lumotni ko'pincha uzun xatboshilardan ko'ra samaraliroq yetkazib beradi.

words.definitionEn: to depict sb/sth as sth - to describe or show someone or something in a particular way
words.exampleEn: The media often depict migration as a threat rather than an opportunity.
words.exampleUz: OAV migratsiyani ko'pincha imkoniyat emas, balki tahdid sifatida tasvirlaydi.

words.definitionEn: to portray sb/sth as sth - to present a person or situation in a certain light
words.exampleEn: Advertisements tend to portray success purely in material terms.
words.exampleUz: Reklamalar muvaffaqiyatni ko'pincha faqat moddiy tomondan ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: to be characterised by sth - to have something as a typical feature
words.exampleEn: The modern labour market is characterised by frequent changes of career.
words.exampleUz: Zamonaviy mehnat bozori kasbning tez-tez o'zgarishi bilan tavsiflanadi.

words.definitionEn: to classify sth as sth - to put things into groups according to shared features
words.exampleEn: These jobs are usually classified as low-skilled, although they require experience.
words.exampleUz: Bu ishlar tajriba talab qilsa-da, odatda past malakali ish sifatida tasniflanadi.

words.definitionEn: to delve into sth - to examine a subject deeply rather than on the surface
words.exampleEn: Space does not allow me to delve into the historical background here.
words.exampleUz: Hajm cheklovi tufayli bu yerda tarixiy fonni chuqur o'rganib bo'lmaydi.

words.definitionEn: to differentiate between A and B - to see or show the difference between two things
words.exampleEn: It is essential to differentiate between correlation and causation.
words.exampleUz: Bog'liqlik bilan sababiyatni farqlash juda muhim.

words.definitionEn: to distinguish A from B - to recognise the difference that separates two things
words.exampleEn: Students must learn to distinguish reliable sources from unverified posts.
words.exampleUz: O'quvchilar ishonchli manbalarni tekshirilmagan postlardan ajrata bilishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: to contrast A with B - to compare two things in order to show how different they are
words.exampleEn: The essay contrasts life in rural areas with life in rapidly growing cities.
words.exampleUz: Insho qishloq hayotini tez o'sayotgan shaharlardagi hayot bilan qiyoslab farqini ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: to derive sth from sth - to obtain a benefit or conclusion from a particular source
words.exampleEn: Many countries derive a large share of their income from tourism.
words.exampleUz: Ko'plab davlatlar daromadining katta qismini turizmdan oladi.

words.definitionEn: to conclude that... - to decide something after considering the evidence
words.exampleEn: The study concludes that smaller classes improve results only slightly.
words.exampleUz: Tadqiqot kichik sinflar natijalarni faqat sal yaxshilaydi, degan xulosaga keladi.

words.definitionEn: to generalise about sth - to make a broad statement based on only a few cases
words.exampleEn: It is risky to generalise about a whole generation from a single survey.
words.exampleUz: Bitta so'rov asosida butun bir avlod haqida umumiy xulosa chiqarish xavfli.

words.definitionEn: to justify sth - to give good reasons why something is right or necessary
words.exampleEn: Writers must justify every claim they make with relevant evidence.
words.exampleUz: Mualliflar har bir da'vosini tegishli dalillar bilan asoslab berishi shart.

words.definitionEn: to validate a theory/result - to show by testing that it is correct
words.exampleEn: Further experiments are needed to validate these preliminary results.
words.exampleUz: Bu dastlabki natijalarning to'g'riligini tasdiqlash uchun qo'shimcha tajribalar zarur.

words.definitionEn: to verify sth - to check that a fact or figure is accurate
words.exampleEn: Readers should verify statistics before quoting them in an argument.
words.exampleUz: O'quvchilar statistikani dalil sifatida keltirishdan oldin uni tekshirib ko'rishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: to bolster an argument/a claim - to add something that makes it stronger
words.exampleEn: The writer bolsters her argument with figures from three separate studies.
words.exampleUz: Muallif o'z dalilini uchta alohida tadqiqot raqamlari bilan kuchaytiradi.

words.definitionEn: to undermine an argument/confidence - to make it weaker or less believable
words.exampleEn: One weak example can undermine an otherwise strong essay.
words.exampleUz: Bitta zaif misol boshqa jihatdan kuchli inshoga putur yetkazishi mumkin.

words.translation: shubha ostiga olmoq, qarshi fikr bildirmoq
words.definitionEn: to challenge an assumption/a view - to question whether it is right
words.exampleEn: Recent research challenges the assumption that homework improves results.
words.exampleUz: So'nggi tadqiqotlar uy vazifasi natijalarni yaxshilaydi, degan qarashni shubha ostiga oladi.

words.definitionEn: to observe that... - to say what you have noticed, often in a formal text
words.exampleEn: As several scholars have observed, the problem is far from new.
words.exampleUz: Bir qancha olimlar qayd etganidek, bu muammo aslo yangi emas.

words.definitionEn: the central idea that a piece of writing sets out to prove
words.exampleEn: Your thesis should appear in the introduction and guide the whole essay.
words.exampleUz: Asosiy fikringiz kirish qismida berilib, butun inshoga yo'nalish berishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: to make a claim - a statement that something is true, which may need proof
words.exampleEn: This is a bold claim that the author never fully supports.
words.exampleUz: Bu muallif to'liq asoslab bermagan jasur da'vodir.

words.definitionEn: a note in a text showing where an idea or quotation came from
words.exampleEn: Every borrowed idea requires a citation, even if you use your own words.
words.exampleUz: O'z so'zlaringiz bilan yozsangiz ham, olingan har bir fikr uchun manba ko'rsatilishi shart.

words.definitionEn: with reference to sth - a mention of a source or of another text
words.exampleEn: The essay makes reference to two recent reports on air quality.
words.exampleUz: Inshoda havo sifati bo'yicha ikkita so'nggi hisobotga havola qilinadi.

words.definitionEn: an argument given against the position you are discussing
words.exampleEn: A balanced essay presents at least one counterargument before the conclusion.
words.exampleUz: Muvozanatli inshoda xulosadan oldin kamida bitta qarshi dalil keltiriladi.

words.definitionEn: a reply that shows why an opposing argument is wrong
words.exampleEn: Her rebuttal of the opposing view was short but effective.
words.exampleUz: Uning qarshi qarashga bergan rad javobi qisqa, ammo ta'sirli edi.

words.definitionEn: a confident statement that something is true, usually without proof
words.exampleEn: The assertion that technology destroys jobs needs much stronger support.
words.exampleUz: Texnologiya ish o'rinlarini yo'q qiladi, degan qat'iy fikr ancha kuchli asos talab qiladi.

words.definitionEn: my contention is that... - the main point you are arguing for
words.exampleEn: My contention is that examinations measure memory rather than ability.
words.exampleUz: Mening asosiy fikrim shuki, imtihonlar qobiliyatni emas, xotirani o'lchaydi.

words.definitionEn: a statement or suggestion put forward for people to consider
words.exampleEn: The proposition that university should be free deserves careful examination.
words.exampleUz: Oliy ta'lim bepul bo'lishi kerak, degan taklif diqqat bilan o'rganishga arziydi.

words.definitionEn: a set of ideas or rules used as a basis for analysis or policy
words.exampleEn: The paper uses a simple framework to compare three education systems.
words.exampleUz: Maqolada uchta ta'lim tizimini qiyoslash uchun oddiy tahlil tuzilmasidan foydalaniladi.

words.definitionEn: the special words used in a particular subject or field
words.exampleEn: Candidates should use precise terminology when writing about the economy.
words.exampleUz: Nomzodlar iqtisodiyot haqida yozganda aniq atamalardan foydalanishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: using someone else's words or ideas as if they were your own
words.exampleEn: Universities punish plagiarism severely, even in first-year essays.
words.exampleUz: Universitetlar hatto birinchi kurs insholarida ham plagiatni qattiq jazolaydi.

words.definitionEn: to place emphasis on sth - special importance given to one point
words.exampleEn: Modern curricula place greater emphasis on critical thinking than on memorising.
words.exampleUz: Zamonaviy o'quv dasturlari yodlashdan ko'ra tanqidiy fikrlashga ko'proq urg'u beradi.

words.definitionEn: a short description of the main features of something
words.exampleEn: The chart gives a clear overview of population change since 1990.
words.exampleUz: Diagramma 1990-yildan beri aholi o'zgarishi haqida aniq umumiy tasavvur beradi.

words.definitionEn: a small but important difference in meaning or opinion
words.exampleEn: This debate has many nuances that simple 'yes or no' answers ignore.
words.exampleUz: Bu bahsning oddiy 'ha yoki yo'q' javoblari e'tiborsiz qoldiradigan ko'plab nozik jihatlari bor.

words.definitionEn: a warning that limits how far a statement or result can be trusted
words.exampleEn: These results are encouraging, with one important caveat: the sample was very small.
words.exampleUz: Bu natijalar ilhomlantiruvchi, biroq bir muhim izoh bor: tanlanma juda kichik edi.

words.translation: dastlabki shart, asos qilib olingan fikr
words.definitionEn: a statement accepted as true and used as the basis of an argument
words.exampleEn: The whole argument rests on the premise that people always act rationally.
words.exampleUz: Butun dalil odamlar doim oqilona ish tutadi, degan asosga tayanadi.

words.definitionEn: a mistaken belief, or a mistake in reasoning that makes an argument invalid
words.exampleEn: It is a common fallacy that spending more on education automatically raises standards.
words.exampleUz: Ta'limga ko'proq mablag' sarflash darajani o'z-o'zidan oshiradi, degan qarash keng tarqalgan xatodir.

words.definitionEn: a discrepancy between A and B - a difference between figures or accounts that should match
words.exampleEn: There is a clear discrepancy between official figures and independent estimates.
words.exampleUz: Rasmiy raqamlar bilan mustaqil baholar o'rtasida aniq nomuvofiqlik bor.

words.definitionEn: the implications of sth - the possible effects or results of a decision or fact
words.exampleEn: This policy has serious implications for low-income families.
words.exampleUz: Bu siyosat kam ta'minlangan oilalar uchun jiddiy oqibatlarga ega.

words.definitionEn: the rationale behind sth - the reasons and thinking that explain a decision
words.exampleEn: The rationale behind the ban is to reduce accidents near schools.
words.exampleUz: Taqiq ortidagi asos maktablar yaqinidagi baxtsiz hodisalarni kamaytirishdir.

words.definitionEn: to draw an inference - a conclusion you reach from evidence rather than direct proof
words.exampleEn: The obvious inference is that families are spending less on entertainment.
words.exampleUz: Bundan chiqadigan aniq xulosa shuki, oilalar ko'ngilochar xarajatlarni kamaytirmoqda.

words.definitionEn: to deduce that... - to reach a conclusion by reasoning logically from known facts
words.exampleEn: From the sharp fall in sales we can deduce that customers found the price too high.
words.exampleUz: Savdoning keskin tushishidan mijozlar narxni juda baland deb topganini aniqlash mumkin.

words.definitionEn: to imply that... - to suggest something without stating it directly
words.exampleEn: The data do not imply that money alone determines happiness.
words.exampleUz: Ma'lumotlar baxtni faqat pul belgilaydi, degan ma'noni anglatmaydi.

words.definitionEn: to correlate with sth - to have a close connection with something that changes too
words.exampleEn: Life expectancy correlates closely with access to clean drinking water.
words.exampleUz: Umr ko'rish davomiyligi toza ichimlik suvi bilan ta'minlanish darajasiga chambarchas bog'liq.

words.definitionEn: the relationship in which one event directly causes another
words.exampleEn: Correlation does not prove causation, however convincing the pattern looks.
words.exampleUz: Manzara qanchalik ishonarli ko'rinmasin, bog'liqlik sababiyatni isbotlamaydi.

words.definitionEn: a causal link/relationship - connected as cause and effect
words.exampleEn: No causal link has been proved between screen time and poor grades.
words.exampleUz: Ekran oldida o'tirish va past baholar o'rtasida sababiy bog'liqlik isbotlanmagan.

words.definitionEn: something in a study that can change and may affect the result
words.exampleEn: The researchers controlled for age, income and other variables.
words.exampleUz: Tadqiqotchilar yosh, daromad va boshqa o'zgaruvchi omillarni hisobga olishdi.

words.definitionEn: a standard used for judging or deciding something (plural: criteria)
words.exampleEn: Exam scores should not be the only criterion for university admission.
words.exampleUz: Imtihon ballari universitetga qabul uchun yagona mezon bo'lmasligi kerak.

words.definitionEn: a limit or factor that defines how something can be done or measured
words.exampleEn: The essay question sets clear parameters for the discussion.
words.exampleUz: Insho savoli muhokama uchun aniq chegaralar belgilab beradi.

words.definitionEn: a determinant of sth - a factor that decides what something will be like
words.exampleEn: Parental education remains the strongest determinant of a child's success.
words.exampleUz: Ota-onaning ma'lumoti bolaning muvaffaqiyatini belgilovchi eng kuchli omil bo'lib qolmoqda.

words.definitionEn: a fluctuation in sth - a repeated rise and fall in a number or level
words.exampleEn: The graph shows sharp fluctuations in oil prices over the decade.
words.exampleUz: Grafik o'n yil davomida neft narxidagi keskin tebranishlarni ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: a disparity between A and B - a large and unfair difference
words.exampleEn: The disparity between urban and rural schools continues to widen.
words.exampleUz: Shahar va qishloq maktablari o'rtasidagi farq kengayib bormoqda.

words.definitionEn: a divergence between A and B - the process of two things becoming different
words.exampleEn: There is a growing divergence between public opinion and government policy.
words.exampleUz: Jamoatchilik fikri bilan hukumat siyosati o'rtasidagi tafovut ortib bormoqda.

words.definitionEn: the process by which different things gradually become similar
words.exampleEn: We are witnessing a convergence of education systems across the region.
words.exampleUz: Mintaqadagi ta'lim tizimlarining o'zaro yaqinlashuvini kuzatmoqdamiz.

words.definitionEn: a deviation from sth - a difference from the usual or expected standard
words.exampleEn: Any deviation from the agreed method makes the results hard to compare.
words.exampleUz: Kelishilgan usuldan har qanday chetlanish natijalarni qiyoslashni qiyinlashtiradi.

words.definitionEn: something that is different from what is normal or expected
words.exampleEn: The figure for 2020 is an anomaly caused by the pandemic.
words.exampleUz: 2020-yilgi ko'rsatkich pandemiya keltirib chiqargan g'ayrioddiy holatdir.

words.definitionEn: a proportion of sth - a part of a whole, often expressed as a percentage
words.exampleEn: A growing proportion of graduates now work in the service sector.
words.exampleUz: Bitiruvchilarning tobora ortib borayotgan ulushi xizmat ko'rsatish sohasida ishlaydi.

words.definitionEn: the ratio of A to B - the relationship between two amounts expressed in numbers
words.exampleEn: The student-teacher ratio in rural schools is far from ideal.
words.exampleUz: Qishloq maktablarida o'quvchi-o'qituvchi nisbati ideal holatdan uzoq.

words.definitionEn: the magnitude of sth - the great size or importance of a problem or change
words.exampleEn: Few politicians appreciate the magnitude of the water crisis.
words.exampleUz: Siyosatchilarning kam qismi suv inqirozining ko'lamini tushunadi.

words.definitionEn: the incidence of sth - how often a problem or disease occurs in a population
words.exampleEn: The incidence of diabetes has doubled among young adults.
words.exampleUz: Yosh kattalar orasida qandli diabet uchrashi ikki baravar oshdi.

words.definitionEn: the prevalence of sth - the fact that something exists widely in a group or place
words.exampleEn: The prevalence of fast food outlets partly explains rising obesity rates.
words.exampleUz: Tez tayyorlanadigan ovqat shoxobchalarining keng tarqalgani semizlik o'sishini qisman izohlaydi.

words.definitionEn: a representative sample - a small group studied in order to draw conclusions about a larger one
words.exampleEn: The study used a representative sample of 1,000 households.
words.exampleUz: Tadqiqotda 1000 xonadondan iborat vakillik tanlanmasidan foydalanilgan.

words.definitionEn: an unfair preference that prevents a fair judgement
words.exampleEn: Media bias makes it difficult for voters to compare the two parties fairly.
words.exampleUz: OAVning bir tomonlamaligi saylovchilarga ikki partiyani xolis qiyoslashni qiyinlashtiradi.

words.definitionEn: to make an assumption - something you accept as true without proof
words.exampleEn: This argument is based on the assumption that all students have internet access.
words.exampleUz: Bu dalil barcha o'quvchilarda internet bor, degan taxminga asoslanadi.

words.definitionEn: a contradiction between A and B - a situation in which two statements cannot both be true
words.exampleEn: There is an obvious contradiction between promoting tourism and protecting nature.
words.exampleUz: Turizmni rivojlantirish va tabiatni asrash o'rtasida yaqqol ziddiyat bor.

words.definitionEn: a lack of logical agreement between statements or actions
words.exampleEn: Critics point to inconsistencies in the government's environmental policy.
words.exampleUz: Tanqidchilar hukumat ekologiya siyosatidagi nomuvofiqliklarga ishora qilishadi.

words.definitionEn: to draw a distinction between A and B - to show clearly how two things differ
words.exampleEn: We must draw a distinction between free speech and harmful content.
words.exampleUz: So'z erkinligi bilan zararli kontent o'rtasida aniq farq o'tkazishimiz kerak.

words.definitionEn: to draw an analogy between A and B - a comparison that explains one thing by another
words.exampleEn: The writer draws an analogy between the economy and a living organism.
words.exampleUz: Muallif iqtisodiyotni tirik organizmga qiyoslaydi.

words.definitionEn: an opinion formed without real evidence
words.exampleEn: Without reliable data, any estimate of the cost is pure conjecture.
words.exampleUz: Ishonchli ma'lumotsiz xarajat bo'yicha har qanday baho quruq taxmindir.

words.definitionEn: guessing about something when the facts are not known
words.exampleEn: Much of the debate is based on speculation rather than solid research.
words.exampleUz: Bahsning katta qismi puxta tadqiqotga emas, asossiz mulohazalarga asoslangan.

words.definitionEn: to extrapolate from sth - to use present data to estimate what will happen later
words.exampleEn: If we extrapolate from current trends, the city will double in size by 2050.
words.exampleUz: Hozirgi tendensiyalardan kelib chiqsak, shahar 2050-yilga borib ikki baravar kattalashadi.

words.definitionEn: the process of thinking logically in order to reach a conclusion
words.exampleEn: The conclusion may be correct, but the reasoning behind it is weak.
words.exampleUz: Xulosa to'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin, ammo uning ortidagi mulohaza zaif.

words.definitionEn: the validity of an argument/a test - the quality of being logically sound or accurate
words.exampleEn: Several experts have questioned the validity of these test results.
words.exampleUz: Bir necha ekspert bu test natijalarining asosliligini shubha ostiga oldi.

words.definitionEn: the quality of deserving to be believed and trusted
words.exampleEn: Anonymous websites simply lack the credibility of peer-reviewed journals.
words.exampleUz: Anonim veb-saytlar taqriz qilingan ilmiy jurnallar kabi ishonchga ega emas.

words.definitionEn: the relevance of sth to sth - the degree to which something is connected to the topic
words.exampleEn: Examiners often criticise essays that include facts of doubtful relevance.
words.exampleUz: Imtihon oluvchilar mavzuga aloqasi shubhali faktlar keltirilgan insholarni tez-tez tanqid qiladi.

words.definitionEn: the limitations of sth - the things that a method or plan cannot do
words.exampleEn: The main limitation of this study is its narrow age range.
words.exampleUz: Bu tadqiqotning asosiy cheklovi yosh doirasining torligidir.

words.definitionEn: financial/time constraints - something that limits what you are able to do
words.exampleEn: Financial constraints prevent many families from sending children abroad.
words.exampleUz: Moliyaviy cheklovlar ko'p oilalarga bolalarini chet elga yuborishga to'sqinlik qiladi.

words.definitionEn: a fault or weakness in a system, plan or person
words.exampleEn: The report admits the shortcomings of the current testing system.
words.exampleUz: Hisobot hozirgi test tizimining nuqsonlarini tan oladi.

words.definitionEn: the merits of sth - the good qualities or advantages of something
words.exampleEn: Both approaches have merits, but only one is affordable for poorer regions.
words.exampleUz: Ikkala yondashuvning ham afzalliklari bor, biroq faqat bittasi kambag'al hududlar uchun arzon tushadi.

words.translation: murosa, biridan voz kechish hisobiga yutuq
words.definitionEn: a trade-off between A and B - a balance in which you accept less of one thing to get more of another
words.exampleEn: There is always a trade-off between economic growth and environmental protection.
words.exampleUz: Iqtisodiy o'sish bilan atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish o'rtasida doim murosa qilishga to'g'ri keladi.

words.definitionEn: to set a precedent - an earlier case that is used as an example for later ones
words.exampleEn: Allowing one exception would set a dangerous precedent for other schools.
words.exampleUz: Bitta istisnoga yo'l qo'yish boshqa maktablar uchun xavfli namuna yaratadi.

words.definitionEn: a prerequisite for sth - something that must exist before something else is possible
words.exampleEn: A stable electricity supply is a prerequisite for digital education.
words.exampleUz: Barqaror elektr ta'minoti raqamli ta'lim uchun zaruriy shartdir.

words.definitionEn: repercussions of sth - the indirect and usually bad effects that follow an event
words.exampleEn: Closing the factory had serious repercussions for the whole town.
words.exampleUz: Zavodning yopilishi butun shaharcha uchun jiddiy salbiy oqibatlarga olib keldi.

words.definitionEn: the ramifications of sth - the many complicated results of a decision
words.exampleEn: Few voters understand the long-term ramifications of such a reform.
words.exampleUz: Kam sonli saylovchi bunday islohotning uzoq muddatli oqibatlarini tushunadi.

words.definitionEn: a catalyst for sth - an event or person that causes an important change to begin
words.exampleEn: The pandemic acted as a catalyst for the shift to online services.
words.exampleUz: Pandemiya onlayn xizmatlarga o'tish uchun turtki bo'ldi.

words.definitionEn: a key driver of sth - a main force that causes something to develop
words.exampleEn: Cheap internet has been the key driver of small business growth.
words.exampleUz: Arzon internet kichik biznes o'sishining asosiy harakatlantiruvchi kuchi bo'ldi.

words.definitionEn: the underlying cause/problem - the real reason behind what can be seen
words.exampleEn: Traffic jams are only a symptom; the underlying cause is poor urban planning.
words.exampleUz: Tirbandlik faqat alomat; chuqur sabab shaharsozlik rejalashtirishning yomonligidir.

words.definitionEn: contingent on sth - depending on something else happening first
words.exampleEn: Further funding is contingent on the success of the pilot project.
words.exampleUz: Qo'shimcha moliyalashtirish sinov loyihasining muvaffaqiyatiga bog'liq.

words.definitionEn: conducive to sth - making a particular result more likely
words.exampleEn: A noisy shared flat is hardly conducive to serious study.
words.exampleUz: Shovqinli umumiy kvartira jiddiy o'qish uchun mutlaqo qulay emas.

words.definitionEn: detrimental to sth - causing harm or damage to something
words.exampleEn: Excessive screen time is detrimental to children's sleep patterns.
words.exampleUz: Ekran oldida haddan ortiq vaqt o'tkazish bolalar uyqusiga zararli ta'sir qiladi.

words.definitionEn: instrumental in doing sth - playing an important part in making something happen
words.exampleEn: Volunteers were instrumental in setting up the community library.
words.exampleUz: Ko'ngillilar mahalla kutubxonasini tashkil etishda hal qiluvchi rol o'ynadi.

words.definitionEn: integral to sth - forming a necessary part of something
words.exampleEn: Feedback is an integral part of any effective learning process.
words.exampleUz: Fikr-mulohaza har qanday samarali o'quv jarayonining ajralmas qismidir.

words.definitionEn: inherent in sth - existing as a natural and permanent feature of something
words.exampleEn: There are risks inherent in any system that relies on private data.
words.exampleUz: Shaxsiy ma'lumotlarga tayanadigan har qanday tizimga xos xavflar mavjud.

words.definitionEn: intrinsic value/motivation - coming from inside rather than from outside rewards
words.exampleEn: Intrinsic motivation matters more than prizes in long-term learning.
words.exampleUz: Uzoq muddatli o'qishda ichki qiziqish mukofotlardan ko'ra muhimroq.

words.definitionEn: done according to a careful plan and in an organised way
words.exampleEn: The problem requires a systematic approach rather than isolated measures.
words.exampleUz: Muammo alohida choralar emas, tizimli yondashuvni talab qiladi.

words.definitionEn: anecdotal evidence - based on personal stories rather than proper research
words.exampleEn: The claim rests on anecdotal evidence rather than statistical proof.
words.exampleUz: Bu da'vo statistik dalilga emas, shaxsiy hikoyalarga tayanadi.

words.definitionEn: quantitative data - based on numbers and measurable amounts
words.exampleEn: Quantitative data show the trend, but interviews explain why it exists.
words.exampleUz: Miqdoriy ma'lumotlar tendensiyani ko'rsatadi, suhbatlar esa uning sababini izohlaydi.

words.definitionEn: qualitative research - based on the quality of experiences rather than numbers
words.exampleEn: Qualitative research gives a deeper picture of learners' real difficulties.
words.exampleUz: Sifatiy tadqiqot o'quvchilarning haqiqiy qiyinchiliklari haqida chuqurroq tasavvur beradi.

words.definitionEn: disproportionate to sth - too large or too small compared with something else
words.exampleEn: Rural families spend a disproportionate share of their income on transport.
words.exampleUz: Qishloq oilalari daromadining nomutanosib katta qismini transportga sarflaydi.

words.definitionEn: the cumulative effect of sth - increasing gradually as more is added
words.exampleEn: The cumulative effect of small savings can be considerable over a decade.
words.exampleUz: Kichik jamg'armalarning to'planib boradigan ta'siri o'n yil ichida sezilarli bo'lishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: happening after something else that has already been mentioned
words.exampleEn: The law was passed in 2019, and subsequent reports show mixed results.
words.exampleUz: Qonun 2019-yilda qabul qilingan va keyingi hisobotlar turlicha natijalarni ko'rsatmoqda.

words.definitionEn: to stem from sth - to be caused by something
words.exampleEn: Much of this frustration stems from a lack of clear information.
words.exampleUz: Bu noroziligning katta qismi aniq axborot yetishmasligidan kelib chiqadi.

words.definitionEn: to give rise to sth - to cause something, especially a problem or question
words.exampleEn: Rapid urban growth has given rise to serious housing shortages.
words.exampleUz: Shaharlarning tez o'sishi jiddiy uy-joy tanqisligini keltirib chiqardi.

words.definitionEn: to account for sth - to explain the reason for something, or to form a part of a total
words.exampleEn: Agriculture accounts for roughly a quarter of the country's employment.
words.exampleUz: Qishloq xo'jaligi mamlakat bandligining taxminan chorak qismini tashkil etadi.

words.definitionEn: to hinge on sth - to depend completely on one particular thing
words.exampleEn: The whole argument hinges on whether the data are reliable.
words.exampleUz: Butun dalil ma'lumotlarning ishonchli yoki ishonchsizligiga bog'liq.

words.definitionEn: to rule sth out - to decide that something is impossible or not worth considering
words.exampleEn: We cannot rule out the possibility that other factors are involved.
words.exampleUz: Boshqa omillar ham ishtirok etayotgan bo'lishi ehtimolini istisno qila olmaymiz.

words.definitionEn: to offset sth - to balance a negative effect with an equal positive one
words.exampleEn: Higher wages may be offset by rising prices in the long run.
words.exampleUz: Yuqori maoshlar uzoq muddatda narxlarning oshishi bilan qoplanib ketishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: to outweigh sth - to be more important or valuable than something else
words.exampleEn: In my view, the benefits of studying abroad clearly outweigh the drawbacks.
words.exampleUz: Menimcha, chet elda o'qishning foydalari kamchiliklaridan ancha ustun.

words.definitionEn: to mitigate the effects of sth - to make something bad less serious
words.exampleEn: Planting trees can mitigate the effects of extreme summer heat in cities.
words.exampleUz: Daraxt ekish shaharlarda yozgi jazirama ta'sirini yumshatishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: to exacerbate a problem - to make a bad situation worse
words.exampleEn: Cutting public transport would only exacerbate air pollution in the capital.
words.exampleUz: Jamoat transportini qisqartirish poytaxtdagi havo ifloslanishini yanada battar qiladi.

words.definitionEn: a tenuous link/connection - so weak that it is hard to believe
words.exampleEn: The link between video games and real violence remains tenuous.
words.exampleUz: Video o'yinlar bilan haqiqiy zo'ravonlik o'rtasidagi bog'liqlik hamon zaifligicha qolmoqda.

words.definitionEn: used to say that something can reasonably be argued, though others may disagree
words.exampleEn: Education is arguably the most effective way to reduce inequality.
words.exampleUz: Aytish mumkinki, ta'lim tengsizlikni kamaytirishning eng samarali yo'lidir.

words.definitionEn: according to what is claimed, although this may not be the real reason
words.exampleEn: The tax was introduced ostensibly to protect the environment.
words.exampleUz: Soliq ko'rinishidan atrof-muhitni himoya qilish uchun joriy etilgan edi.

words.definitionEn: according to what people say, although it may not be true
words.exampleEn: The scheme purportedly helps small farmers, but few have received support.
words.exampleUz: Dastur go'yoki kichik fermerlarga yordam beradi, ammo kam kishi yordam olgan.

words.definitionEn: a marginal difference/improvement - so small that it hardly matters
words.exampleEn: The new method produced only a marginal improvement in test scores.
words.exampleUz: Yangi usul test ballarida faqat juda kichik yaxshilanish berdi.

words.definitionEn: a persuasive argument - able to make people believe or agree with you
words.exampleEn: She presents a persuasive case for raising the school leaving age.
words.exampleUz: U maktabni tugatish yoshini oshirish foydasiga ishontira oladigan dalil keltiradi.

words.definitionEn: a reputable source/company - respected and generally trusted
words.exampleEn: Always support your points with figures from reputable sources.
words.exampleUz: Fikrlaringizni doim obro'li manbalardan olingan raqamlar bilan asoslang.

words.definitionEn: of dubious value/quality - probably not true, honest or useful
words.exampleEn: Many online courses are of dubious quality and offer no real qualification.
words.exampleUz: Ko'plab onlayn kurslarning sifati shubhali va ular haqiqiy malaka bermaydi.

words.definitionEn: not certainly true or right; deserving to be doubted
words.exampleEn: It is highly questionable whether banning phones would improve behaviour.
words.exampleUz: Telefonlarni taqiqlash xulqni yaxshilashi juda shubhali.

words.definitionEn: a flawed argument/study - containing a mistake that weakens it
words.exampleEn: The study is seriously flawed because it ignores regional differences.
words.exampleUz: Tadqiqot hududiy farqlarni e'tiborsiz qoldirgani uchun jiddiy nuqsonlidir.

words.definitionEn: treating a complex problem as if it were much simpler than it is
words.exampleEn: Blaming unemployment on laziness is a simplistic view of a complex issue.
words.exampleUz: Ishsizlikni dangasalikka yuklash murakkab masalaga haddan tashqari sodda qarashdir.

words.definitionEn: dealing only with the obvious surface of a subject, not in depth
words.exampleEn: Social media often gives students a superficial understanding of history.
words.exampleUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar ko'pincha o'quvchilarga tarix haqida yuzaki tasavvur beradi.

words.definitionEn: a sound argument/policy - based on good reasoning and therefore reliable
words.exampleEn: His conclusion is based on sound economic reasoning.
words.exampleUz: Uning xulosasi puxta iqtisodiy mulohazaga asoslangan.

words.definitionEn: robust evidence/data - strong enough to withstand criticism
words.exampleEn: There is now robust evidence that early intervention saves money later.
words.exampleUz: Hozir erta aralashuv keyinchalik mablag' tejashini isbotlovchi ishonchli dalillar bor.

words.definitionEn: rigorous testing/analysis - done very carefully and with strict standards
words.exampleEn: Such claims should be tested by rigorous independent research.
words.exampleUz: Bunday da'volar qat'iy mustaqil tadqiqot orqali sinovdan o'tkazilishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: a valid point/reason - based on truth or good sense, so hard to argue against
words.exampleEn: Opponents of the plan raise a valid point about long-term costs.
words.exampleUz: Reja muxoliflari uzoq muddatli xarajatlar haqida o'rinli fikr bildiradi.

words.definitionEn: fully justified - having good reasons that make something acceptable
words.exampleEn: Public anger about rising food prices is entirely justified.
words.exampleUz: Oziq-ovqat narxining oshishi bo'yicha jamoatchilik noroziligi to'liq o'rinlidir.

words.definitionEn: warranted by sth - justified by the situation, especially of a strong action
words.exampleEn: Such strict measures are simply not warranted by the current risk.
words.exampleUz: Hozirgi xavf darajasi bunday qat'iy choralarni aslo oqlamaydi.

words.definitionEn: unfounded fears/claims - not supported by any facts or evidence
words.exampleEn: Fears that machines will replace all teachers are largely unfounded.
words.exampleUz: Mashinalar barcha o'qituvchilar o'rnini egallaydi, degan qo'rquv asosan asossizdir.

words.definitionEn: biased towards/against sb - unfairly supporting one side
words.exampleEn: Reports funded by industry are often biased in favour of their sponsors.
words.exampleUz: Sanoat tomonidan moliyalashtirilgan hisobotlar ko'pincha homiylar foydasiga bir tomonlama bo'ladi.

words.definitionEn: based on facts rather than on personal feelings
words.exampleEn: An academic essay should remain objective even on emotional topics.
words.exampleUz: Ilmiy insho hissiyotli mavzularda ham xolis bo'lib qolishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: based on personal taste or opinion rather than facts
words.exampleEn: Marking essays is more subjective than marking multiple-choice tests.
words.exampleUz: Insholarni baholash test topshiriqlarini baholashdan ko'ra ko'proq shaxsiy qarashga bog'liq.

words.definitionEn: not supporting either side in an argument or competition
words.exampleEn: Voters need impartial information, not political advertising.
words.exampleUz: Saylovchilarga siyosiy reklama emas, beg'araz axborot kerak.

words.definitionEn: a tentative conclusion - not final, and possibly changed later
words.exampleEn: These are tentative conclusions that further research may well revise.
words.exampleUz: Bular keyingi tadqiqotlar o'zgartirishi mumkin bo'lgan dastlabki xulosalardir.

words.definitionEn: possible to do in practice, especially with the money and time available
words.exampleEn: A four-day working week is feasible for offices but not for hospitals.
words.exampleUz: To'rt kunlik ish haftasi ofislar uchun amalga oshsa bo'ladi, ammo kasalxonalar uchun emas.

words.definitionEn: a viable alternative/option - able to work successfully over time
words.exampleEn: Solar power is now a viable alternative for remote villages.
words.exampleUz: Quyosh energiyasi endi olis qishloqlar uchun hayotiy muqobil variantdir.

words.definitionEn: a pragmatic approach - dealing with problems in a practical rather than ideal way
words.exampleEn: A pragmatic approach would be to improve existing schools first.
words.exampleUz: Amaliy yondashuv avvalo mavjud maktablarni yaxshilash bo'lardi.

words.definitionEn: it would be prudent to do sth - sensible and careful about future risks
words.exampleEn: It would be prudent to test the system in one city before national rollout.
words.exampleUz: Tizimni butun mamlakatga joriy etishdan oldin bitta shaharda sinab ko'rish oqilona bo'lardi.

words.definitionEn: worth having or doing, because it brings advantages
words.exampleEn: Smaller class sizes are desirable, but they are expensive to provide.
words.exampleUz: Sinflarning kichikroq bo'lishi maqbul, biroq buni ta'minlash qimmatga tushadi.

words.definitionEn: so small or unimportant that it can be ignored
words.exampleEn: The effect on air quality has been negligible so far.
words.exampleUz: Hozirgacha havo sifatiga ta'siri arzimas darajada bo'ldi.

words.definitionEn: large enough in amount or degree to be important
words.exampleEn: The reform would require substantial investment in teacher training.
words.exampleUz: Islohot o'qituvchilarni tayyorlashga salmoqli sarmoya talab qiladi.

words.definitionEn: having the opposite effect to the one intended
words.exampleEn: Punishing students for asking questions is clearly counterproductive.
words.exampleUz: O'quvchilarni savol bergani uchun jazolash aniq teskari natija beradi.

words.definitionEn: a legitimate concern/reason - fair and acceptable, and therefore worth listening to
words.exampleEn: Parents have legitimate concerns about the safety of online platforms.
words.exampleUz: Ota-onalarning onlayn platformalar xavfsizligi haqidagi tashvishlari o'rinlidir.

words.definitionEn: an authoritative source/study - respected because it is written by real experts
words.exampleEn: The World Bank report is the most authoritative source on this topic.
words.exampleUz: Jahon banki hisoboti bu mavzudagi eng nufuzli manbadir.

words.definitionEn: conclusive evidence/proof - so clear that no doubt remains
words.exampleEn: There is still no conclusive evidence that the policy reduced crime.
words.exampleUz: Bu siyosat jinoyatchilikni kamaytirgani haqida hanuz qat'iy dalil yo'q.

words.definitionEn: a contentious issue - likely to cause strong disagreement
words.exampleEn: Compulsory military service remains a contentious issue among young people.
words.exampleUz: Majburiy harbiy xizmat yoshlar orasida hamon bahsli masala bo'lib qolmoqda.

words.definitionEn: it is debatable whether... - not certain, because people can reasonably disagree
words.exampleEn: It is debatable whether higher fines actually change driver behaviour.
words.exampleUz: Jarimalarni oshirish haydovchilar xulqini haqiqatan o'zgartirishi bahs talab.

words.definitionEn: worth the time, money or effort that it costs
words.exampleEn: Learning a second foreign language is a worthwhile investment of time.
words.exampleUz: Ikkinchi chet tilini o'rganish vaqt sarflashga arziydigan sarmoyadir.

words.definitionEn: beneficial to sb/sth - having a good effect on someone or something
words.exampleEn: Part-time work can be highly beneficial to students' independence.
words.exampleUz: Yarim kunlik ish talabalarning mustaqilligi uchun juda foydali bo'lishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: of paramount importance - more important than anything else
words.exampleEn: In any medical reform, patient safety must be paramount.
words.exampleUz: Har qanday tibbiy islohotda bemor xavfsizligi birinchi o'rinda turishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: indispensable to sb/sth - so necessary that you cannot manage without it
words.exampleEn: For many rural families, a mobile phone has become indispensable.
words.exampleUz: Ko'plab qishloq oilalari uchun mobil telefon o'ta zarur vositaga aylandi.

words.definitionEn: used to say that something is probably true, based on what you know
words.exampleEn: Presumably, the authorities expected the reform to pay for itself.
words.exampleUz: Ehtimol, hokimiyat islohot o'z xarajatini qoplaydi deb kutgandir.

words.definitionEn: appearing to be true, although this may not be the case
words.exampleEn: The seemingly obvious solution often turns out to be the most expensive.
words.exampleUz: Ko'rinishidan aniq bo'lgan yechim ko'pincha eng qimmat yechim bo'lib chiqadi.

words.definitionEn: used when something is claimed but not proved
words.exampleEn: The company allegedly ignored safety rules for several years.
words.exampleUz: Da'vo qilinishicha, kompaniya bir necha yil xavfsizlik qoidalarini e'tiborsiz qoldirgan.

words.definitionEn: according to reports, though the speaker cannot confirm it
words.exampleEn: Reportedly, more than half of graduates now work remotely.
words.exampleUz: Xabarlarga ko'ra, bitiruvchilarning yarmidan ko'pi hozir masofadan ishlaydi.

words.definitionEn: used to say that something is possible, even if unlikely
words.exampleEn: Such a policy could conceivably reduce traffic, but the cost is enormous.
words.exampleUz: Bunday siyosat, ehtimol, tirbandlikni kamaytirar, biroq xarajati juda katta.

words.definitionEn: used to accept a point that weakens your own argument slightly
words.exampleEn: Admittedly, online lessons are cheaper, but they suit only motivated learners.
words.exampleUz: Tan olish kerakki, onlayn darslar arzonroq, ammo ular faqat qiziqqan o'quvchilarga mos.

words.definitionEn: always, without any exception
words.exampleEn: Reforms introduced without consultation almost invariably fail.
words.exampleUz: Maslahatlashuvsiz joriy etilgan islohotlar deyarli doimo muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraydi.

words.definitionEn: mostly, but not completely
words.exampleEn: The success of the project was largely due to community support.
words.exampleUz: Loyihaning muvaffaqiyati asosan mahalla ko'magi tufayli bo'ldi.

words.definitionEn: mainly; more than anything else
words.exampleEn: The workforce in this sector is predominantly young and urban.
words.exampleUz: Bu sohadagi ishchi kuchi asosan yosh va shaharlik.

words.definitionEn: in a way that is very easy to notice
words.exampleEn: Attitudes to working mothers have changed markedly in ten years.
words.exampleUz: Ishlaydigan onalarga munosabat o'n yilda sezilarli darajada o'zgardi.

words.definitionEn: scepticism about sth - an attitude of doubt about a claim or plan
words.exampleEn: There is widespread scepticism about the promised results.
words.exampleUz: Va'da qilingan natijalarga nisbatan keng tarqalgan shubha mavjud.

words.definitionEn: used to state the most important point after considering everything
words.exampleEn: Ultimately, the decision should rest with the students themselves.
words.exampleUz: Pirovardida, qaror talabalarning o'ziga bog'liq bo'lishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: in the most basic and important way
words.exampleEn: The two systems are fundamentally different in how they assess progress.
words.exampleUz: Ikki tizim taraqqiyotni baholash usuli bo'yicha tubdan farq qiladi.

words.definitionEn: to overstate the case - to describe something as more important than it really is
words.exampleEn: Critics of the reform tend to overstate the risks involved.
words.exampleUz: Islohot tanqidchilari undagi xavflarni bo'rttirib ko'rsatishga moyil.

words.definitionEn: to understate sth - to say that something is smaller or less serious than it is
words.exampleEn: Official statistics almost certainly understate the level of informal employment.
words.exampleUz: Rasmiy statistika norasmiy bandlik darajasini deyarli aniq kamaytirib ko'rsatadi.

words.definitionEn: to downplay sth - to make something seem less important than it is
words.exampleEn: The company downplayed the environmental impact of the new plant.
words.exampleUz: Kompaniya yangi zavodning atrof-muhitga ta'siri ahamiyatini pasaytirdi.

words.definitionEn: to be deemed sth - to be officially or widely considered to be something
words.exampleEn: Any answer written in pencil is deemed invalid by the examiners.
words.exampleUz: Qalamda yozilgan har qanday javob imtihon oluvchilar tomonidan haqiqiy emas deb hisoblanadi.

words.definitionEn: to be regarded as sth - to be thought of in a particular way by people
words.exampleEn: Volunteering is widely regarded as valuable work experience.
words.exampleUz: Ko'ngillilik faoliyati keng doirada qimmatli ish tajribasi deb qaraladi.

words.definitionEn: to maintain that... - to keep saying that something is true, despite disagreement
words.exampleEn: Supporters maintain that the new rules protect ordinary consumers.
words.exampleUz: Tarafdorlar yangi qoidalar oddiy iste'molchilarni himoya qiladi, deb qat'iy turib oladi.

words.definitionEn: to endorse a proposal/view - to say publicly that you support it
words.exampleEn: Most teachers' unions have endorsed the proposed changes to the timetable.
words.exampleUz: Ko'pchilik o'qituvchilar uyushmalari dars jadvalidagi o'zgarishlarni qo'llab-quvvatladi.

words.definitionEn: to condemn sth - to say strongly that something is wrong or unacceptable
words.exampleEn: Human rights groups condemned the decision to restrict access to information.
words.exampleUz: Inson huquqlari tashkilotlari axborotdan foydalanishni cheklash qarorini qoraladi.

words.definitionEn: to favour sth - to prefer one option or policy to another
words.exampleEn: Personally, I would favour investing in prevention rather than in new hospitals.
words.exampleUz: Shaxsan men yangi kasalxonalarga emas, profilaktikaga sarmoya kiritishni afzal ko'rgan bo'lardim.

words.definitionEn: to weigh up the pros and cons - to consider advantages and disadvantages before deciding
words.exampleEn: Before choosing a career, young people should weigh up salary and satisfaction.
words.exampleUz: Kasb tanlashdan oldin yoshlar maosh va qoniqishni taroziga solib ko'rishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: to evaluate sth - to judge how good, useful or successful something is
words.exampleEn: It is too early to evaluate the impact of the new curriculum.
words.exampleUz: Yangi o'quv dasturining ta'sirini baholash uchun hali erta.

words.definitionEn: to cast doubt on sth - to make people uncertain whether something is true
words.exampleEn: New figures cast doubt on the government's claim of falling unemployment.
words.exampleUz: Yangi raqamlar hukumatning ishsizlik kamaymoqda degan da'vosini shubha ostiga oladi.

words.definitionEn: a common misconception - a belief that many people hold but which is wrong
words.exampleEn: It is a common misconception that children learn languages effortlessly.
words.exampleUz: Bolalar tillarni osongina o'rganadi, degan keng tarqalgan noto'g'ri tasavvur bor.

words.definitionEn: a paradigm shift - a whole way of thinking about a subject that people accept at a given time
words.exampleEn: Remote work has brought about a paradigm shift in office culture.
words.exampleUz: Masofaviy ish ofis madaniyatida tubdan yangi yondashuvni keltirib chiqardi.

words.definitionEn: a dichotomy between A and B - a sharp division between two opposite ideas
words.exampleEn: The dichotomy between work and family life is less clear than it once was.
words.exampleUz: Ish va oila hayoti o'rtasidagi keskin chegara ilgarigidek aniq emas.

words.definitionEn: a wide spectrum of sth - a complete range of opinions, people or conditions
words.exampleEn: The survey covered a broad spectrum of opinions on the reform.
words.exampleUz: So'rov islohot yuzasidan fikrlarning keng doirasini qamrab oldi.

words.definitionEn: the level at which something starts to happen or to have an effect
words.exampleEn: Families below a certain income threshold receive extra state support.
words.exampleUz: Ma'lum daromad chegarasidan past oilalar davlatdan qo'shimcha yordam oladi.

words.definitionEn: to reach a consensus - general agreement among a group of people
words.exampleEn: There is now a broad consensus that the exam system needs reform.
words.exampleUz: Hozir imtihon tizimi islohotga muhtoj ekani bo'yicha keng yakdillik mavjud.

words.definitionEn: from an economic/historical perspective - a particular way of looking at a situation
words.exampleEn: From an economic perspective, cheap public transport pays for itself.
words.exampleUz: Iqtisodiy nuqtai nazardan, arzon jamoat transporti o'z xarajatini qoplaydi.

words.definitionEn: an abstract idea that helps people understand something
words.exampleEn: The concept of lifelong learning is still new in many workplaces.
words.exampleUz: Umrbod o'rganish tushunchasi ko'plab ish joylarida hamon yangilik.

words.definitionEn: a basic rule or belief that guides behaviour or a system
words.exampleEn: Equal access to education is a principle few would openly reject.
words.exampleUz: Ta'limdan teng foydalanish — kam odam ochiqchasiga rad etadigan tamoyil.

words.definitionEn: social norms - standards of behaviour that are usual in a society
words.exampleEn: Working from home has become the norm in many IT companies.
words.exampleUz: Uydan ishlash ko'plab IT kompaniyalarida odatiy holga aylandi.

words.definitionEn: social conventions - a traditional way of behaving that most people follow
words.exampleEn: Social conventions about marriage age are changing rapidly in the region.
words.exampleUz: Mintaqada turmush qurish yoshi haqidagi an'anaviy qarashlar tez o'zgarmoqda.

words.definitionEn: a set of political or social beliefs shared by a group
words.exampleEn: Economic policy is too often driven by ideology rather than evidence.
words.exampleUz: Iqtisodiy siyosat ko'pincha dalillarga emas, mafkuraga tayanadi.

words.definitionEn: a fixed way of thinking that shapes how someone reacts to situations
words.exampleEn: Changing this mindset is harder than changing the law.
words.exampleUz: Bunday tafakkur tarzini o'zgartirish qonunni o'zgartirishdan qiyinroq.

words.definitionEn: a person's general attitude to life, or the likely future of a situation
words.exampleEn: The economic outlook for young graduates has improved slightly.
words.exampleUz: Yosh bitiruvchilar uchun iqtisodiy istiqbol biroz yaxshilandi.

words.definitionEn: the freedom of a person or institution to make its own decisions
words.exampleEn: Teachers need more autonomy in choosing their classroom materials.
words.exampleUz: O'qituvchilarga dars materiallarini tanlashda ko'proq mustaqillik kerak.

words.definitionEn: cultural/national identity - the qualities that make a person or group who they are
words.exampleEn: Learning a mother tongue is central to preserving cultural identity.
words.exampleUz: Ona tilini o'rganish milliy o'zlikni saqlashda markaziy o'rin tutadi.

words.definitionEn: support and unity among people who share the same aims
words.exampleEn: The crisis produced remarkable solidarity among neighbours.
words.exampleUz: Inqiroz qo'shnilar o'rtasida ajoyib birdamlikni yuzaga keltirdi.

words.definitionEn: social cohesion - the state in which the members of a society are united
words.exampleEn: Shared public spaces contribute to social cohesion in growing cities.
words.exampleUz: Umumiy jamoat maydonlari o'sib borayotgan shaharlarda ijtimoiy jipslikka hissa qo'shadi.

words.definitionEn: fairness in the way people are treated, taking their different needs into account
words.exampleEn: True equity means giving extra help to schools with fewer resources.
words.exampleUz: Haqiqiy adolat resursi kam maktablarga qo'shimcha yordam berishni anglatadi.

words.definitionEn: principles about what is right and wrong behaviour
words.exampleEn: Debates about genetic research quickly turn into questions of morality.
words.exampleUz: Genetik tadqiqotlar haqidagi bahslar tezda axloq masalasiga aylanadi.

words.definitionEn: the moral rules that govern behaviour in a profession or activity
words.exampleEn: Journalists are expected to follow a strict code of ethics.
words.exampleUz: Jurnalistlardan qat'iy axloq kodeksiga amal qilish kutiladi.

words.definitionEn: the practice of doing things openly so that people can see what is happening
words.exampleEn: Greater transparency in spending would increase public trust.
words.exampleUz: Xarajatlardagi kattaroq shaffoflik jamoatchilik ishonchini oshirgan bo'lardi.

words.definitionEn: entitlement to sth - the official right to receive or do something
words.exampleEn: Every citizen has an entitlement to free basic healthcare.
words.exampleUz: Har bir fuqaro bepul boshlang'ich tibbiy yordam olish huquqiga ega.

words.definitionEn: a system in which people or things are ranked one above another
words.exampleEn: Strict hierarchies in the workplace can discourage young employees from speaking up.
words.exampleUz: Ish joyidagi qat'iy ierarxiya yosh xodimlarni fikr bildirishdan qaytarishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: complicated official rules and paperwork that slow things down
words.exampleEn: Excessive bureaucracy discourages small businesses from expanding.
words.exampleUz: Haddan ortiq rasmiyatchilik kichik korxonalarni kengayishdan qaytaradi.

words.definitionEn: the basic systems such as roads, power and water that a country needs
words.exampleEn: Without reliable digital infrastructure, online education cannot reach villages.
words.exampleUz: Ishonchli raqamli infratuzilmasiz onlayn ta'lim qishloqlarga yetib bormaydi.

words.definitionEn: an incentive to do sth - something that encourages people to act in a certain way
words.exampleEn: Tax breaks give companies an incentive to hire recent graduates.
words.exampleUz: Soliq imtiyozlari kompaniyalarga yangi bitiruvchilarni ishga olish uchun rag'bat beradi.

words.definitionEn: a deterrent to sth - something that makes people less likely to do something bad
words.exampleEn: Heavier fines have proved a weak deterrent to dangerous driving.
words.exampleUz: Og'ir jarimalar xavfli haydashdan qaytaruvchi zaif chora bo'lib chiqdi.

words.definitionEn: the stigma attached to sth - strong social disapproval of a condition or choice
words.exampleEn: The stigma attached to mental illness prevents many people from seeking help.
words.exampleUz: Ruhiy kasalliklarga qo'yilgan salbiy tamg'a ko'plarni yordam so'rashdan to'xtatadi.

words.definitionEn: prejudice against sb - an unfair opinion formed without knowledge or reason
words.exampleEn: Prejudice against rural applicants still affects hiring in some firms.
words.exampleUz: Ba'zi firmalarda qishloqdan kelgan nomzodlarga nisbatan salbiy qarash hanuz ishga qabulga ta'sir qiladi.

words.definitionEn: a fixed and oversimplified image of a group of people
words.exampleEn: Textbooks should avoid gender stereotypes about who becomes an engineer.
words.exampleUz: Darsliklar kim muhandis bo'lishi haqidagi gender qoliplaridan qochishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: the ability to understand and share another person's feelings
words.exampleEn: Reading fiction is said to develop empathy in young readers.
words.exampleUz: Badiiy adabiyot o'qish yosh kitobxonlarda hamdardlikni rivojlantiradi, deyishadi.

words.definitionEn: the general state of being healthy, comfortable and happy
words.exampleEn: Long working hours have a direct effect on employees' wellbeing.
words.exampleUz: Uzoq ish soatlari xodimlarning ruhiy-jismoniy salomatligiga bevosita ta'sir qiladi.

words.definitionEn: a sense of fulfilment - the feeling of satisfaction from doing something meaningful
words.exampleEn: Many people now seek personal fulfilment rather than a high salary.
words.exampleUz: Hozir ko'p odamlar yuqori maoshdan ko'ra shaxsiy qoniqishni izlaydi.

words.definitionEn: aspirations for sth - a strong wish to achieve something important
words.exampleEn: Schools should raise the aspirations of pupils from poorer families.
words.exampleUz: Maktablar kambag'alroq oilalardan chiqqan o'quvchilarning intilishlarini oshirishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: the state of not having the basic things people need for a decent life
words.exampleEn: Children growing up in deprivation start school already behind.
words.exampleUz: Muhtojlikda o'sgan bolalar maktabga allaqachon ortda qolgan holda keladi.

words.definitionEn: the state of having plenty of money and a comfortable life
words.exampleEn: Growing affluence has changed eating habits across the region.
words.exampleUz: Ortib borayotgan farovonlik mintaqada ovqatlanish odatlarini o'zgartirdi.

words.definitionEn: the condition of being successful and economically strong
words.exampleEn: Long-term prosperity depends on the quality of secondary education.
words.exampleUz: Uzoq muddatli ravnaq o'rta ta'lim sifatiga bog'liq.

words.definitionEn: the process by which trade, culture and communication become worldwide
words.exampleEn: Globalisation has made English essential for many local businesses.
words.exampleUz: Globallashuv ingliz tilini ko'plab mahalliy korxonalar uchun zaruriyatga aylantirdi.

words.definitionEn: the process in which more and more people move to live in cities
words.exampleEn: Rapid urbanisation has put enormous pressure on housing and water supply.
words.exampleUz: Tez shaharlashuv uy-joy va suv ta'minotiga ulkan bosim o'tkazdi.

words.definitionEn: the control of what people are allowed to read, watch or say
words.exampleEn: Censorship of the internet rarely stops information from spreading.
words.exampleUz: Internet senzurasi axborot tarqalishini kamdan-kam to'xtata oladi.

words.definitionEn: social mobility - the ability to move to a better social or economic position
words.exampleEn: Education remains the main route to social mobility for rural youth.
words.exampleUz: Ta'lim qishloq yoshlari uchun ijtimoiy yuksalishning asosiy yo'li bo'lib qolmoqda.

words.definitionEn: the way someone earns the money they need to live
words.exampleEn: Thousands of families depend on cotton for their livelihood.
words.exampleUz: Minglab oilalarning tirikchiligi paxtaga bog'liq.

words.definitionEn: a scarcity of sth - a situation in which there is not enough of something
words.exampleEn: Water scarcity is already reshaping agriculture in Central Asia.
words.exampleUz: Suv tanqisligi Markaziy Osiyoda qishloq xo'jaligini allaqachon o'zgartirmoqda.

words.definitionEn: the depletion of sth - the reduction of a resource until little is left
words.exampleEn: The depletion of groundwater is a serious threat to farming regions.
words.exampleUz: Yer osti suvlarining tugab borishi qishloq xo'jaligi hududlari uchun jiddiy tahdiddir.

words.definitionEn: environmental/land degradation - the process of something becoming damaged in quality
words.exampleEn: Land degradation has reduced harvests in several districts.
words.exampleUz: Yerlarning yaroqsiz holga kelishi bir necha tumanlarda hosildorlikni kamaytirdi.

words.definitionEn: the variety of plants and animals living in a particular area
words.exampleEn: Protecting biodiversity is not a luxury but a form of insurance.
words.exampleUz: Biologik xilma-xillikni asrash dabdaba emas, balki bir turdagi sug'urtadir.

words.definitionEn: adaptation to sth - the process of changing in order to deal with new conditions
words.exampleEn: Adaptation to a hotter climate will require new crops and technologies.
words.exampleUz: Issiqroq iqlimga moslashish yangi ekinlar va texnologiyalarni talab qiladi.

words.definitionEn: a transition from A to B - the process of changing from one state to another
words.exampleEn: The transition from school to university is difficult for many students.
words.exampleUz: Maktabdan universitetga o'tish ko'p talabalar uchun qiyin kechadi.

words.definitionEn: the path that a career, price or situation follows over time
words.exampleEn: If the current trajectory continues, the population will double by 2060.
words.exampleUz: Hozirgi yo'nalish davom etsa, aholi 2060-yilga borib ikki baravar ortadi.

words.definitionEn: a situation in which something is steady and unlikely to change suddenly
words.exampleEn: Investors value political stability more than short-term tax cuts.
words.exampleUz: Investorlar siyosiy barqarorlikni qisqa muddatli soliq imtiyozlaridan yuqori qo'yadi.

words.definitionEn: a state in which the future is not known and cannot be predicted
words.exampleEn: Economic uncertainty makes families reluctant to take out loans.
words.exampleUz: Iqtisodiy noaniqlik oilalarni kredit olishdan tiyilishga majbur qiladi.

words.definitionEn: the quality of having many connected parts that are hard to understand
words.exampleEn: Short news reports rarely capture the complexity of the issue.
words.exampleUz: Qisqa yangiliklar masalaning murakkabligini kamdan-kam yetkazib bera oladi.

words.definitionEn: a tension between A and B - a difficult relationship between two aims or groups
words.exampleEn: There is an obvious tension between economic growth and clean air.
words.exampleUz: Iqtisodiy o'sish va toza havo o'rtasida yaqqol ziddiyat mavjud.

words.definitionEn: the interplay between A and B - the way two things affect each other
words.exampleEn: Success depends on the interplay between talent and opportunity.
words.exampleUz: Muvaffaqiyat iste'dod va imkoniyatning o'zaro ta'siriga bog'liq.

words.definitionEn: a mechanism for doing sth - an official system or method for achieving a result
words.exampleEn: The law provides no clear mechanism for compensating affected families.
words.exampleUz: Qonun zarar ko'rgan oilalarga tovon to'lashning aniq mexanizmini bermaydi.

words.definitionEn: the legacy of sth - a situation that exists because of events in the past
words.exampleEn: Many of today's problems are the legacy of decades of underinvestment.
words.exampleUz: Bugungi muammolarning ko'pi o'nlab yillik kam sarmoyaning merosidir.

words.definitionEn: cultural heritage - the traditions and buildings passed down from earlier generations
words.exampleEn: Tourism can either protect cultural heritage or gradually destroy it.
words.exampleUz: Turizm madaniy merosni ham asrashi, ham asta-sekin yo'q qilishi mumkin.

words.definitionEn: integration into sth - the process of becoming a full part of a group or society
words.exampleEn: Language courses are the fastest route to the integration of newcomers.
words.exampleUz: Til kurslari yangi kelganlarning jamiyatga qo'shilishining eng tez yo'lidir.

words.definitionEn: to reach a compromise - an agreement in which each side gives up part of its demands
words.exampleEn: Any workable solution will require a compromise between farmers and city dwellers.
words.exampleUz: Har qanday amaliy yechim fermerlar va shahar aholisi o'rtasida murosani talab qiladi.

words.definitionEn: good governance - the way in which a country or organisation is managed
words.exampleEn: Good governance matters more than the size of the budget.
words.exampleUz: Yaxshi boshqaruv byudjet hajmidan ko'ra muhimroq.

words.definitionEn: the legal status of being a citizen, with its rights and duties
words.exampleEn: Schools should teach active citizenship alongside academic subjects.
words.exampleUz: Maktablar akademik fanlar bilan birga faol fuqarolikni ham o'rgatishi kerak.

words.definitionEn: an obligation to do sth - a moral or legal duty to act in a certain way
words.exampleEn: Wealthy countries have an obligation to help those most affected by drought.
words.exampleUz: Boy davlatlar qurg'oqchilikdan eng ko'p zarar ko'rganlarga yordam berish majburiyatiga ega.

words.definitionEn: a financial/administrative burden - a heavy responsibility that is difficult to carry
words.exampleEn: Private tuition places a heavy financial burden on average families.
words.exampleUz: Xususiy repetitorlik o'rtahol oilalar zimmasiga og'ir moliyaviy yuk yuklaydi.
